security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Framework laptop companion: telemetry, fan control, keyboard configurator
bundle.longDescription: The all-in-one desktop companion for Framework laptops. Live oscilloscope telemetry, fan control, power management, battery health, keyboard/macropad configuration, LED Matrix painting, and system info in one native app.
